site.title: HelloTraveler: Every Place Has a Story Worth Hearing
site.metaDescription: HelloTraveler turns your camera into a personal cultural guide, identifying landmarks, translating signs, and narrating local history in English and Tagalog.
site.announcementText: Explore landmarks worldwide with bilingual audio tours.

hero.title: Your Personal Tour Guide
hero.subtitle: No research needed. Explore nearby places or point your camera and hear the story behind what you see.
hero.heroAudioQuote: "Hello Traveler! Look up at the sign reading MOTOGO Home and soak in this stunning example of traditional Hmong architecture nestled in the Ha Giang mountains..."
hero.heroCardBody: From historic heritage streets to remote mountain roads around the world, every stop saves automatically into your My Travel Notes journal.

capabilities.label: Everything you need to understand every place you visit

identify.heading: Don't just take a photo. Unlock centuries of history.
identify.lead1: Most travelers snap a picture of an old stone arch, ancestral house, or monument and walk away never knowing who built it or why it matters. HelloTraveler changes that in a single tap.
identify.lead2: Open your camera, upload a shot from your gallery, or try a sample photo. Within seconds, HelloTraveler recognizes the structure, classifies its architectural heritage, and shares a deeply researched story tailored to where you're standing.
bullets: Live camera lens or gallery upload that works even after you leave the site
Identifies architecture styles, historic eras, and exact regional context
Includes a built-in sample photo so anyone can test it immediately
identify.ctaLabel: See what happens after you snap

discover.heading: Skip the tourist traps and discover what locals love near you
discover.lead1: Whether you're exploring historic neighborhoods on foot or cruising coastal roads anywhere in the world, the best meals, heritage bell towers, and quiet viewpoints are rarely on generic top-ten lists.
discover.lead2: One tap on Discover Nearby surfaces hand-picked dining, historical landmarks, nature escapes, and local events right around your GPS location, and ready to open directly in Google Maps.
bullets: Curated across four clear pillars: Restaurants, Historical Sites, Nature, and Events
Seamless switch between English and Tagalog descriptions on the spot

audioDemo.heading: Listen hands-free in English or Tagalog
audioDemo.lead1: Keep your eyes on the stone carvings, mountain skyline, and street life around you instead of staring at a wall of tiny text. Every landmark includes a warm, paced audio tour with selectable playback speed (0.85x, 1x, 1.15x).
audioDemo.lead2: Switch languages anytime using the interactive demo on the right to see how HelloTraveler adapts both narration and sign translations seamlessly.

english.title: Audio Tour · English
english.script: "Hello Traveler! Step through the timber archway of MOTOGO Home in Lo Lo Chai Village, high in northern Vietnam. Above you, layered clay roof tiles crown weathered wooden doors framed by geometric stone pillars. Beyond the gate, warm golden earthen walls and vibrant hanging crafts celebrate centuries of Lo Lo highland heritage. Take a moment to soak in the peaceful mountain atmosphere, and remember to ask kindly before photographing local residents in traditional attire."
english.signText: MOTOGO Home, Traditional Lo Lo Highland Homestay, Lo Lo Chai Village

tagalog.title: Audio Tour · Tagalog
tagalog.script: "Hello Traveler! Pumasok ka sa kahoy na arko ng MOTOGO Home sa nayon ng Lo Lo Chai sa hilagang Vietnam. Sa itaas, ang mga tisa sa bubong ay nakapatong sa lumang pintuang kahoy at mga inukit na haliging bato. Sa loob, ipinapakita ng dilaw na pader na lupa at makukulay na palamuti ang maraming siglo ng kulturang Lo Lo. Damhin ang payapang simoy ng bundok, at magpaalam nang magalang bago kumuha ng larawan ng mga residente."
tagalog.signText: MOTOGO Home, Tradisyonal na Tahanang Lo Lo sa Nayon ng Lo Lo Chai

journal.heading: Go deeper, travel with respect, and remember every stop
journal.lead: Every place you identify becomes an editorial journal entry, pairing historical background and cultural etiquette with My Travel Notes and an always-ready personal tour guide.
journal.leftBody: Read clear, respectful context written like a thoughtful travel magazine, covering architectural heritage, symbolic motifs, and how local communities keep centuries-old traditions alive.
etiquetteTips: Always ask for permission before photographing local residents and children.
Remove your shoes before entering traditional indoor living spaces.
Support the local community by purchasing handmade crafts directly from artisans.
journal.rightTitle: Ask Tour Guide & My Travel Notes
journal.rightBody: Curious who built it, what hidden details to look for, or when to visit? Tap a suggested question below, or type your own inside the app, and save personal memories in My Travel Notes alongside every stop.

guideAnswers.built: Traditional Ha Giang homesteads like Motogo Home are crafted by local Hmong families using centuries-old rammed-earth wall techniques and hand-carved limestone pillars passed down across generations.
guideAnswers.details: Look closely at the yin-yang clay roof tiles designed to shed heavy mountain mist, the geometric stone carvings flanking the timber gate, and the ochre earthen plaster that keeps rooms warm on chilly highland nights.
guideAnswers.time: Early morning (7:00 to 9:30 AM) or late afternoon brings soft golden light across the courtyard and quieter village lanes, ideal for respectful photography and chatting with local artisans.

personas.heading: See what HelloTraveler can do for every kind of explorer
personas.lead: Whether you're exploring historic capitals on foot, riding coastal highways, or discovering hidden mountain villages, HelloTraveler meets you right where curiosity strikes.

items.title: For scooter riders & road-trippers
items.body: Pull over at an unexpected roadside temple, viewpoint, or heritage mansion. Snap a photo, pop in an earbud, and hear its story before getting back on the road.

items.title: For culture-first travelers
items.body: Go beyond surface-level checklists. Get respectful local etiquette tips, real-time plaque translations, and architectural history that honors indigenous heritage.

items.title: For storytellers & journal keepers
items.body: Every landmark automatically builds your personal Travel Journal, complete with photos, audio scripts, and My Travel Notes to revisit long after the trip ends.

screenshots.heading: Warm, calm, and crafted for explorers everywhere
screenshots.lead: Built with a flat pastel editorial interface that stays effortless to read in bright sunlight, with zero clutter and zero distractions.
